{
  "name": "animate",
  "displayName": "Animate",
  "description": "Make short procedural animations in any style (explainers, histories, product reels, little stories) as single-file canvas videos. Seven styles built in or a new one from your references; your own music track (beat-mapped) or a composed score; real screenshots of your product; every format from one piece. Intake, story / look / storyboard check-ins, then a measured build to MP4.",
  "version": "0.4.0",
  "author": {
    "name": "cth9191"
  },
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "animation",
    "canvas",
    "video",
    "explainer",
    "storyboard",
    "procedural",
    "motion-graphics",
    "style-transfer"
  ]
}
